item.title: China’s Massive PL-17 Air-To-Air Missile Seen Up Close
item.description: A photo has surfaced that appears to show a mock-up of the roughly 20-foot-long weapon on display at an exhibition. The post China’s Massive PL-17 Air-To-Air Missile Seen Up Close appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Ukrainian Su-25 Shoot-Down Seen In Harrowing Onboard Video
item.description: Highly dangerous missions and limited performance mean the Su-25 has recorded disproportionate losses over Ukraine. The post Ukrainian Su-25 Shoot-Down Seen In Harrowing Onboard Video appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Last New F/A-18 Aft Fuselages Built As Super Hornet Production End Approaches
item.description: Boeing expects to close out production of new Super Hornets in 2027 and has already stopped building EA-18G Growlers. The post Last New F/A-18 Aft Fuselages Built As Super Hornet Production End Approaches appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: F/A-XX Naval Fighter Needed For Adversaries Like Iran, Not Just China and Russia: Navy Boss
item.description: Global proliferation of more capable air defenses means the era of the Navy 'flying with impunity' is increasingly at an end. The post F/A-XX Naval Fighter Needed For Adversaries Like Iran, Not Just China and Russia: Navy Boss appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Destroyer, Electronic Surveillance Jet Joins U.S. Forces Massing In Middle East
item.description: Amid the ongoing military buildup, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that no one knows who would lead Iran next should the Khamenei regime fall. The post Destroyer, Electronic Surveillance Jet Joins U.S. Forces Massing In Middle East appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Future USS John F. Kennedy, Second Ford Class Carrier, Has Set Sail For The First Time
item.description: The Navy hopes to take delivery of the future USS John F. Kennedy next year after repeated delays. The post Future USS John F. Kennedy, Second Ford Class Carrier, Has Set Sail For The First Time appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Lockheed Confirms RQ-170 Sentinel Spy Drones Took Part In Maduro Capture Mission
item.description: RQ-170s have been flying for decades, but official confirmation of any details about their activities is very rare. The post Lockheed Confirms RQ-170 Sentinel Spy Drones Took Part In Maduro Capture Mission appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Top Secret Spy Satellite Declassified By National Reconnaissance Office
item.description: After spying on the electronic signals of adversaries for decades, the NRO's enigmatic Jumpseat spy satellite has emerged from the darkness. The post Top Secret Spy Satellite Declassified By National Reconnaissance Office appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: USAF F-35s Redeploy Across Atlantic From Puerto Rico, Final Destination Unknown

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes On Parked Russian Aircraft Seen In “Greatest Hits” Video
